lines: Three claps first, sounded strong to clear all bar —
with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.
sanskrit_cite: tālatrayam purā dattvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye | śikhāsaṃkhyābhijaptena toyenābhyukṣayet tataḥ

lines: Flowers foremost, all in order — emblem or altar;
with fourteen mutterings, the flower-seat prepare.
sanskrit_cite: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅgaṃ vā stha.ṅdilaṃ ca vā | caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā

lines: There let the hero worship forthgoing, then the seat anew;
casketed, let him the worship-practice pursue.
sanskrit_cite: tatra sṛṣṭiṃ yajed vīraḥ punar evāsanaṃ tataḥ | sṛṣṭiṃ tu sampuṭīkṛtya paścād yajanam ārabhet

lines: All-tattva-full, all-limbed in grace — let fortune's dame
sanskrit_cite: sarvatattvasusampūrṇām sarvāvayavaśobhitām | yajed devīṃ mahābhāgā saptaviṃśatimantritām

lines: Then fragrant flowers, as able, honor pay;
worship with love supreme, and give thyself away.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaiś ca yathāśaktyā samarcayet | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā svātmanaṃ ca nivedayet

lines: Thus worship told; in fire-rite too this way:
who worship-rule hath done, the seed recalls aright, prevails.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yajanam ākhyātam agnikārye 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījam prasiddhyati

lines: Seed with nor head nor tail, abloom, mid-tithi set —
sanskrit_cite: ādyantarahitam bījaṃ vikasat tithimadhyagam | hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśuṃ nityam abhyasyet

lines: What he desires, desires, swiftly shall he gain;
though unknowing, direct sight he'll attain — all-knowing, no doubt's stain.
sanskrit_cite: yān yān kāmayate kāmāṃs tān tāñ cchīghram avāpnuyāt | ajñaḥ pratyakṣatām eti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

lines: Thus is mantra-fruit got — this Rudra-Yāmala's way;
by its rehearsal, powers and all-knowing stay.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ mantraphalāvaptir ity etad rudrayāmalam | etad abhyāsataḥ siddhiḥ sarvajñatvam avāpyate
